fullContent:
Raja Shiraobhushanam 
 Reference – Vaidya Chintamani 
 Introduction 
 Raja Shiraobhushanam is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to be prepared from the mixture of minerals and herbs. This is used to treat problems related with physiological diseases. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Loha Bhasma (iron calx) 
 Hingula (mercury calx) 
 Kanta Loha Bhasma (magnetic iron calx) 
 Swarna Bhasma (gold calx) 
 Mandoora Bhasma (iron oxide calx) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the ingredients are mixed to hingula and this formulation is prepared. 
 Dosage 
 10 grams in 50 doses bid. 
 Indications 
 
 Paralysis 
 Tremors 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
